// Leak (d), second half: REACH A VAULT WITH NOTHING BUT A RUN ID.
//
// PerturbedVaultFor was exported and took a run id, and every classifier already has a run id:
// ctx.Route.Obs().RunID. So a foreign response was readable with no Perturbed in hand at all,
// which is worse than leak (d) proper because it needs nothing stolen.
//
// The by-run-id lookup is unexported now. The runner reaches a vault by minting into it or by
// holding one it opened, and neither of those is nameable from here.
package leakfixture

import "ars0n-framework-v2-server/utils/triage"

func leakVaultByRunID(ctx triage.ClassifyCtx) *triage.PerturbedVault {
	return triage.PerturbedVaultFor(ctx.Route.Obs().RunID)
}
